item.title: Episode 24 - Miscommunication
item.itunes:title: Episode 24 - Miscommunication
item.description:
On this brand new episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang has the man with a ponytail pinned beneath the weight of Greg, Sherwood's large shadow bear, ready to interrogate him. Except, things don't go as planned, and the man with the ponytail seems to be hiding something. What secret does he know, and how will it affect the party? Find out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! If you'd like to keep up with all things Sneak Attack!, you can follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast. You can also write us a review on iTunes and let us know how we're doing. We really appreciate all the support!

item.title: Episode 25 - A Party Divided
item.itunes:title: Episode 25 - A Party Divided
item.description:
On this brand new episode of Sneak Attack!, the group must decide how to proceed after getting separated from each other right before a large band of Pineapoleans arrived to join their leader, James. Would Akio, Brenna, and Sherwood face unspeakable odds to rescue their dwarf companion, or would Greaek's fate be left to the whims of the crazy pineapples? Find out right now, on Sneak Attack!

 

Apologies for the shorter episode today. We had some issues during recording that cause me to lose track of how much time we had spent playing. Next week's will be back to normal. Thanks everyone for listening, and please feel free to write us if you have any thoughts or questions about the show at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com, or you can drop us a line on Twitter @SneakPodcast. We love hearing from you guys!

item.title: Episode 26 - Sandhaven
item.itunes:title: Episode 26 - Sandhaven
item.description:
On this episode of Sneak Attack!, the party cautiously follows the Pineapple Gang on their way to deal with a captured Greaek. Brenna, Akio, and Sherwood are disguised, allowing them to travel along side the Pineappoleans. Would their charade fail before they could save Greaek? Where are the Pineapple Gang taking the dwarf? Would they ever return to High Rock? Find out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! Follow us throughout the week on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or you can leave us a review on iTunes! We love hearing from you all throughout the week!

item.title: Episode 27 - A Budding Romance
item.itunes:title: Episode 27 - A Budding Romance
item.description:
On this brand new episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang must clean up the mess caused by Akio's sleepy potions, while Sherwood attempts to woo the beautiful gnome restauranteur. Brenna, meanwhile, searches the rest of the city for information and discovers its political influence. Find out what the party does with the unconscious Pineapoleans, right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! Keep up to date with Sneak Attack! throughout the week on Twitter by follow us @SneakPodcast.

item.title: Episode 28 - The Negotiations
item.itunes:title: Episode 28 - The Negotiations
item.description:
On this installment of Sneak Attack!, the gang must hatch a plan in order to leave the city of Sandhaven, escort the Pineapple Gang to High Rock to present to the Minister, all without disrupting the economy and under-the-table dealings of Taegan Brightspire, Bishop of the small community. How would they craft such a plan, and would they be able to put all the pieces in place? Found out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! We really appreciate the love and support we get for this show, and would love to hear from our listeners. You can write us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or email us at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. You can also write a review on iTunes!

item.title: Episode 39 - The Chronikum, Part 2
item.itunes:title: Episode 39 - The Chronikum, Part 2
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang continues to fight their way through the mysterious and dangerous Sky Temple. Akio is dangling from a rock monster high above the ground, and the rest of the group doesn't seem to be fairing much better. Will they prove up to the task, or will the temple defeat them as it has so many others? Find out now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening to the show. If you are interested in filling out the demographics survey, you can do so here: https://survey.libsyn.com/sneakattack

item.itunes:title: Episode 46 - Left or Right
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang gets further into trouble after separating outside the ruined city of High Rock. Sherwood and Greaek are making their way through the Willow Peaks, while Brenna and Akio have met up with the Resistance. What is next in store for our heroes? Find out now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! If you like the show, follow us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or you can leave us a review on iTunes! Thanks also to Battlebards for letting us use their sound effects! You can find them here: https://battlebards.com

 

Dungeons and Dragons, D&D, Role Playing Game, RPG, Tabletop, Actual Play
